tasks.title: Server-side cache and resilient fetch utility
tasks.description: Build the shared HTTP layer used by all providers: in-memory TTL cache, request coalescing, timeouts, retries with exponential backoff and 429 handling.
tasks.details: Implement `cachedFetch(key, ttlMs, fn)` with an in-memory Map (bounded LRU, ~500 entries) and in-flight promise coalescing so concurrent identical requests share one upstream call. Implement `fetchJson(url, {timeoutMs, retries, headers})` using AbortController (default 8 s timeout), retrying on network errors/5xx with backoff 1 s, 2 s, 4 s (max 30 s) and honouring Retry-After on 429. Return typed errors (`UpstreamError {source, status, retryable}`) and never leak upstream bodies or headers. Support serving stale cache entries when the upstream fails (stale-if-error), returning a `stale: true` flag.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest with fake timers and a mocked fetch: TTL expiry, coalescing (two concurrent calls → one fetch), retry sequence on 503, Retry-After respected on 429, timeout aborts, stale-if-error returns the cached value with stale flag.

tasks.title: Gold price provider (XAUS) with PAXG fallback
tasks.description: Implement the gold provider: live spot price in USD per troy ounce, hourly and daily history, with an automatic PAXG-based fallback.
tasks.details: providers/xaus.ts: `getGoldSpot()` → GET https://xaus.com/api/v1/spot?unit=oz&currency=USD&compact=1, parse `xau.price`, `price_as_of`, `stale` with Zod; cache 60 s. `getGoldHistory(range)` → GET /api/v1/chart?symbol=xau&range=<1mo|3mo|6mo|1y|5y|max>&interval=<1h|1d>; map 7d to range=1mo interval=1h and trim. Normalise to `{t (ms UTC), usdPerOz}`. providers/paxg.ts: fallback spot via CoinGecko simple/price for `pax-gold` and history via market_chart or Binance PAXGUSDT klines. Expose a single `GoldProvider` interface returning `{data, source: 'xaus'|'paxg', stale}`. Optional: currency param for TRY display (used by task 13).
tasks.testStrategy: Parser tests against recorded XAUS JSON fixtures (spot, chart 1y daily, chart 1mo hourly); malformed payload rejected by Zod; when XAUS mock returns 503, provider returns PAXG data with source 'paxg'; cache hit avoids second fetch within 60 s.

tasks.title: Crypto providers: CoinGecko (search, spot, ≤365 d) and Binance (long history)
tasks.description: Implement coin search, batched live prices and price history for any coin, using CoinGecko for coverage and Binance klines for history beyond 365 days.
tasks.details: providers/coingecko.ts: send `x-cg-demo-api-key` header. `searchCoins(q)` → /search (map id, symbol, name, thumb, market_cap_rank; cache 24 h per query). `getSpot(ids[])` → /simple/price?ids=…&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true (batched, cache 60 s). `getHistory(id, days)` → /coins/{id}/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=N (hourly for ≤90 d, daily above; demo cap 365 d). providers/binance.ts: `getDailyKlines(symbol)` paginating /api/v3/klines?symbol=<SYM>USDT&interval=1d&limit=1000 by startTime until present; base URL from config. Symbol resolution: CoinGecko symbol upper-cased + 'USDT', verified via /api/v3/exchangeInfo (cached 24 h); unknown pair → `null` so the UI disables 5Y/Max. Keep calls under 50/min to CoinGecko by relying on the task 2 cache.
tasks.testStrategy: Fixture-based parser tests for /search, /simple/price, /market_chart and klines; pagination test assembling >1000 klines across two pages; symbol not on Binance returns null; API key header present on every CoinGecko request and absent from any returned object.

tasks.title: Ratio engine: alignment, forward-fill, units and statistics
tasks.description: Write the pure TypeScript library that turns coin and gold price series into ratio series and statistics, independent of any network code.
tasks.details: src/lib/ratio.ts: `alignSeries(coin, gold, granularity)` keys points by UTC date or hour, forward-fills missing gold values (weekends/holidays) and sets `goldFilled`; drops leading points with no prior gold value. `toRatio(points)` → ratioOz = coinUsd / goldUsdOz. `ozToGram(x) = x * 31.1034768`. `indexTo100(series)`. `computeStats(series)` → current, changePct, high {value,t}, low {value,t}, avg, ma30, ma90, percentile of current within range. src/lib/format.ts: number formatting rules from PRD §7.2 (2 decimals ≥1, 4 significant digits 0.01–1, compact for <0.01, mg hint for grams), percent with sign and arrow. No React or fetch imports in lib/.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest with ≥90 % line coverage: weekend forward-fill (Fri gold used for Sat/Sun crypto), leading-gap drop, hourly alignment, gram conversion exact to 1e-9 relative error, stats on a hand-computed 10-point series, indexTo100 first value equals 100, formatting table-driven tests for each magnitude band.

tasks.title: Internal API routes: /api/search, /api/spot, /api/history
tasks.description: Expose the providers and ratio engine through three validated, cached Next.js route handlers that the browser calls.
tasks.details: Route handlers in src/app/api/*/route.ts. Validate query params with Zod (search q 2–50 chars; spot ids ≤ 20; history id + range ∈ 7d,1m,3m,6m,1y,5y,max). /api/spot combines GoldProvider spot and CoinGecko batched spot → `{gold:{usdPerOz, asOf, source, stale}, coins:[{id, usd, change24h, ratioOz, asOf}]}`. /api/history picks coin source by range (CoinGecko ≤365 d, Binance beyond; truncate and set `meta.truncated` + `availableFrom` when data is shorter), fetches gold history at matching granularity, aligns via lib/ratio, returns `{id, range, granularity, points, meta:{coinSource, goldSource, availableFrom, truncated}}`. Error envelope `{error, source}` with 400/502. Cache-Control headers per PRD §7.5. Never include API keys or upstream bodies in responses.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests calling route handlers with mocked providers: happy path for each route; 400 on bad params; 502 when all upstreams fail; gold fallback reflected in meta.goldSource; 5y request for a coin without Binance pair returns truncated=true; response JSON scanned to assert the API key string never appears.

tasks.title: Plain-language summary generator
tasks.description: Implement the deterministic, unit-aware template engine that writes the 2–4 sentence summary under the chart.
tasks.details: src/lib/summary.ts: `buildSummary({symbol, series, stats, unit, range, goldSource, truncatedDays})` → `{sentences: string[], text}`. Implements PRD §7.4: S1 current value with secondary unit in parentheses; S2 change with 'up'/'down'/'roughly flat' (<1 %); S3 position vs period high (top half) or low (bottom half), 'at a new period high/low' within 0.5 %; S4 trend only for ranges ≥3M using ratio change ±1 % and ma30 vs ma90. Edge cases: <2 points, truncated range, PAXG fallback note. Max 60 words. Uses lib/format for numbers; no external free text. Also export `buildOneLiner()` for watchlist rows (e.g. '19.79 oz · ▲2.1 % 24h').
tasks.testStrategy: Table-driven Vitest cases for every sentence rule and edge case in PRD §7.4, in both oz and g; word-count ≤60 assertion; snapshot of the BTC example; ≥90 % line coverage.
